description: This file implements an authentication service class for a backend application using Supabase for user management and JWT for token handling. It provides methods for user signup, login, and token verification, along with internal utility to create JWT tokens.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A service class handling user authentication operations including signup, login, and token verification.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] signup_user(self, signup_data: SignupRequest)
methods.description: Registers a new user via Supabase Authentication, then generates a JWT token, returning user info.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] login_user(self, login_data: LoginRequest)
methods.description: Authenticates an existing user via Supabase Authentication and returns a JWT token with user info.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] verify_token(self, token: str)
methods.description: Verifies a provided JWT token and retrieves the associated user info if valid.

methods.name: _create_access_token(self, data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None)
methods.description: Creates a JWT access token with an expiration, encoding user data.

ctags.name: _create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^    def _create_access_token(self, data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None):$/

ctags.name: login_user
ctags.pattern: /^    async def login_user(self, login_data: LoginRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: signup_user
ctags.pattern: /^    async def signup_user(self, signup_data: SignupRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: verify_token
ctags.pattern: /^    async def verify_token(self, token: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
